cohort: 266 pregnant mothers beyond 34 weeks of gestation, divided into groups based on Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI < 5 vs. AFI > 5).
finding: Oligohydramnios beyond 34 weeks of gestation was significantly associated with a higher rate of caesarean section and fetal growth restriction.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean section was significantly higher in the oligohydramnios group.
